material.acceptance_criteria: applyFrame(new Map(), deltaFrame) leaves the map unchanged, or its contract names the precondition and the caller guard is unnecessary.
material.description: js/client/delta.js:35-43 applyFrame applies a delta frame to any Map, including an empty one; the header comment (lines 33-34) says the receiver ignores deltas before one state frame. That guard exists only in js/client/play.js:545-546 (netBaseline). Deep-module fix: state the precondition in the interface or enforce it inside applyFrame so callers need no protocol knowledge.
material.resolution: verifier gm-orch-1-14-v1: applyFrame rejects a delta with no baseline; play.js netBaseline guard removed. CI run 39065835817 success on tip e03ee19 (24/24 jobs), which contains this sha
